title: 1BD Sleeps 4 | 1.2 Miles to Grand Ole Opry
description:
Music City One-Bedroom Retreat

Just one mile from the Grand Ole Opry, this spacious one-bedroom suite sleeps up to 4 with a king bed, queen sleeper sofa, full kitchen, and in-suite washer/dryer — many units also feature a private balcony. Resort amenities include indoor and outdoor pools, a hot tub, fitness center, barbecue area, and activities program. Walk to Opry Mills shopping and dining, with easy access to downtown Nashville, Jack Daniel's Distillery, and the Country Music Hall of Fame.
